rows.rationale: THE LIVE BUG. A Goulds 3196 PUMP listing on Pumpman (opaque URL /category-s/355.htm, no slug). The page text mentions 'mechanical seal kit' (echoing the seal-led query). Current detector: longest-synonym-first -> 'mechanical seal' (15) beats 'pump' (4) -> SEAL -> same-class gate ~1.0 -> survives at ~46%. CORRECT verdict: the vendor 'Pumpman' + domain 'shoppumps.com' + 'pump distributor' all say PUMP; the 'seal kit' is incidental. Must be classified PUMP and crushed (different class) below floor. expected should_pass_floor=FALSE.

Contaminated: pump page whose text contains 'mechanical seal' (query echo). Current detector -> SEAL (longest synonym) -> gate ~1.0 -> wrongly survives. Correct: PUMP (vendor + 'pump' is the product; 'mechanical seal' is a component OF the pump, echoed from the query). Must FAIL floor.

Contaminated pump-on-seal. URL slug /pump/centrifugal/ says PUMP, but snippet also says 'Mechanical seal replacement' (query echo). Current detector: URL-wins-on-disagreement -> PUMP (URL slug present) -> gate 0.1 -> crushed. This case should ALREADY fail correctly (URL slug saves it) — included to confirm the URL-slug path works and contrast with the opaque-URL Pumpman cases that don't.

Contaminated valve-on-bearing. Request is a ball bearing; result is a brass ball VALVE whose text mentions 'Bearing-compatible' (query echo of 'bearing'). Current detector: 'ball bearing'(len 11) or 'bearing'(7) vs 'ball valve'(9) -> longest-synonym-first may pick BEARING -> same-class gate -> wrongly survives. Correct: VALVE (the product is a valve; 'bearing-compatible' is incidental). Must FAIL floor. Tests the contamination generalizes beyond seal/pump.

Contaminated motor-on-seal. Result is a MOTOR whose text mentions 'Shaft seal' (query echo). Current detector: 'shaft seal'(len 10) or 'seal'(4) vs 'motor'(5) or 'pump motor' -> longest-synonym may pick SEAL -> same-class gate -> wrongly survives. Correct: MOTOR (the product; 'shaft seal included' is incidental). Must FAIL floor.

Contaminated impeller-on-seal. Result is an IMPELLER whose text mentions 'Mechanical seal compatible' (query echo). Current detector: 'mechanical seal'(15) vs 'impeller'(8) -> SEAL -> same-class gate -> wrongly survives. Correct: IMPELLER (the product; 'seal compatible' is incidental). Must FAIL floor.

True positive: a REAL seal specialist. Must STILL pass after the fix — the dominant-class detector must classify it SEAL (the product IS a seal; 'mechanical seal' is the product, not an echo) and the gate stays ~1.0. Guards against the fix over-correcting and crushing real seals.

True positive: a real seal kit aftermarket. The text says 'seal kit' (the product) and 'pump' is NOT mentioned, so no contamination. Must pass. Guards the anti-inversion: a marketplace/specialist that legitimately sells the seal must still beat a pump.
Clean-PN no-regression true positive. Must pass flag-on and flag-off. Guards against the fix perturbing clean cases.

True positive: a CORRECT pump on a PUMP request. The dominant-class detector must classify it PUMP and the gate stays ~1.0. Guards the fix doesn't penalize pumps generally — only pumps-on-seal-requests. Mirrors the redesign eval's goulds_pump_correct_on_pump_request.

Clean negative: the SAME Pumpman opaque-URL pump page but WITHOUT the 'seal' contamination in the text. Current detector: 'pump' -> PUMP -> gate 0.1 -> crushed correctly (~4). Confirms the current code already handles the opaque-URL pump when the text doesn't echo the query — isolates the contamination as the sole cause of the bug.

RESIDUAL KNOWN-GAP (do NOT relabel, do NOT stretch the fix). A pump page with an OPAQUE URL (/products/g3196-pump-unit — no part-type slug the dictionary reads, NOT a collection page) AND an UNCLASSIFIABLE vendor/domain ('MB Glick' / 'mbglick.com' carry no noun-class). The structural-signal fix cannot reach it (no vendor/domain class to override the snippet echo), so it STILL wrongly passes after the fix (snippet 'mechanical seal' -> SEAL -> same-class gate ~1.0 -> base survives the floor). This is the honest residual: uncorroborated opaque-URL wrong-part cases remain until the flywheel sizes them with real data (Stage 3 page-fetch/LLM, out of scope). Desired verdict FALSE; reported as known-gap, not asserted.
